workouts.name: Push Day A

workoutExercises.notes: Light weight, high reps, focus on mind-muscle.

workouts.name: Pull Day A
workouts.notes: Back thickness and biceps. Focus on progressive overload.

workoutExercises.notes: Full range of motion, dead hang at bottom.
Drive elbow back, squeeze at top.
Slow eccentric, full stretch at bottom.

workouts.name: Leg Day A
workouts.notes: Quad dominant day. High volume squats.

workoutExercises.notes: Work up to heavy sets. ATG if mobility allows.
Bulgarian style with rear foot elevated.
Hamstring stretch, don't round lower back.
Full ROM, pause at bottom stretch.

workouts.name: Push Day B
workouts.notes: Lighter push day, higher reps for hypertrophy.

workoutExercises.notes: Bodyweight warmup to get blood flowing.
Lighter than Day A, focus on squeeze.

workouts.name: Pull Day B
workouts.notes: Volume pull day. Higher reps, shorter rest.

workoutExercises.notes: 15 min intervals: 1 min hard / 1 min easy.

workouts.name: Upper Body A
workouts.notes: Compound push/pull supersets. Full upper body.

workoutExercises.notes: Warm up with light set first.

workouts.name: Upper Body B
workouts.notes: Lighter upper body, more isolation work.

workouts.name: Lower Body B
workouts.notes: Posterior chain focus. Glutes and hamstrings.
